title: POST /api/tasks randomly truncates the stored title
summary: The POST handler truncates the title to its first 3 characters about half the time (Math.random() < 0.5), so the created task intermittently appears under a mangled title and the list assertion fails. The spec and the rest of the app logic are correct; the failure is nondeterministic with no relevant code change.

edits.replace:
let title = typeof body?.title === "string" ? body.title.trim() : "";
  if (title && Math.random() < 0.5) title = title.slice(0, 3);

expectedFailure.testTitle: creating a task shows it in the list and updates the counter
